mentions.name: HyperServer
mentions.description: A Go framework for building server-rendered web apps with HTMX, built on standard net/http handlers and html/template. It requires no ORM, makes authentication, sessions, and storage optional, and is designed as a reusable library rather than a starter repository to copy. Currently labeled experimental, it powers a functional and fast blog, with plans to use it as a platform for other web projects.
mentions.problem: Inspired by Pagoda but dissatisfied with its dependence on third-party libraries and its starter-repository approach, the author wanted a dependency-light, reusable Go framework for server-rendered HTMX apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: The second project is HyperServer. HyperServer is a Go framework for server-rendered apps with HTMX that I've been working on off and on for a few years.
